$comment: The cross-surface pricing truth: takkada.com and the partner dashboard's plans_pricing config must both match THIS file, key by key. Config keys are the partner-dashboard names; publicName/publicLabel are what this site renders. Changing any price is a deliberate three-way edit (this file, siteContent.js, the dashboard config) — scripts/checkRateCardDrift.mjs fails the build on any one-sided change, in either direction. dashboardOnlyKeys are priced offers the dashboard sells that deliberately never render here; exemptions are site-only blocks priced against setups, not plans.
